records.assetReview: A 5×4×1 dm platform has 20 L volume and 10 kg own mass. At 40 px/dm its front is 200×40 px. The unloaded front has top y280, bottom y320 and waterline y300: depth 20 px, or 1/2 dm. At the loaded limit the front top reaches y300, bottom y340: depth 40 px, or 1 dm. Cargo bottom y300 remains at the surface with no immersed cargo volume. Mass bars 100+100=200 px at 10 px/kg separate own 10 kg from additional 10 kg. Full XML and native rendering confirm the dry load and zero freeboard.
records.distractors: 20 kg is total supported mass, not additional load. 10 N would confuse mass and weight. Dry cargo contributes no extra displacement.
records.manualArithmetic: Full displacement supports rhoV=20 kg total. Platform mass is(1/2)(20)=10 kg, leaving 10 kg additional theoretical load.
records.physicalAssumptions: Rigid homogeneous impermeable platform with 0 < rho_p < rho in quiet homogeneous water of density 1 kg/L. Centered dry load adds weight and displaces no water. Stable vertical equilibrium has no other support. Full external platform volume V is the maximum displacement. m_lim is additional mass at zero freeboard: a theoretical limit, distinct from total mass and a guaranteed operational rating.
